title: AWS re:Invent 2018: How AWS Minimizes the Blast Radius of Failures (ARC338)
summary: An AWS re:Invent 2018 talk on how AWS limits the blast radius of failures. It covers design techniques such as cell-based architecture and shuffle sharding.
why: It is the go-to reference whenever HN discusses cell-based architecture and outage isolation, as an explanation straight from AWS engineers.

quote.text: This YouTube video[1] of a re:invent presentation does a great job of explaining it.
